name: CR-3D (Ingenieurbuero Christian Reil)
summary: Vertically integrated German 3D-printing company in Cham, Bavaria, founded 2016 by Christian Reil. Builds its own printers and slicer and has extruded filament in-house since opening its production line in 2023, spanning commodity PLA/PETG through ESD, flame-retardant and fibre-filled engineering grades. Also offers white-label and OEM extrusion for other brands.

oem_relationships.notes: CR-3D advertises white-label/OEM filament extrusion as a service. No client brand is named, so this edge records the capability rather than a specific counterparty.

product_lines.name: ABS-ESD
product_lines.notes: ABS + conductive filler for static dissipation.

product_lines.name: PETG / PETG Carbon
product_lines.notes: Standard PETG and a carbon-fibre-filled grade.

product_lines.name: FlameX PETG UL94-V0
product_lines.notes: PETG + flame-retardant package rated UL94 V0; no flame-retardant PETG id exists (abs-fr has no PETG equivalent).

product_lines.name: PLA / Crystal / Soft / CF10
product_lines.notes: Base PLA in several finishes plus a 10% carbon-fibre grade. 'Soft' is a modified PLA, not an elastomer.

additional_notes: Pricing spans EUR 39.80 to roughly EUR 178/kg, among the steepest in the German market, reflecting the engineering-grade and certified-flame-retardant end of the range. The company sells printers, a slicer and build surfaces alongside filament; no specific plate id is claimed, so plate_ids is left unset.
